[tab]Tabbed by: Mike Lydiat
E-mail: mike@docsworkshop.co.uk
Tuning:EADGBE[/tab]

The chord pattern is pretty straightforward but they vary the 'interlude' patterns between the verses.
Capo on fret 2 to play along here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZaDBZh4Wzw4
